experiment_data.hypothesis: Few-shot demonstrations (1-shot and 5-shot) reduce the BCS-driven confusability effect (high-BCS accuracy penalty) by grounding type boundaries through explicit examples. If the BCS delta (low-high) shrinks significantly under few-shot, confusability is addressable via better prompting. If delta persists, confusability is a fundamental schema-structural constraint even with demonstrations.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate base && cd /root/schema-dag-extraction && FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1 python3 src/run_fewshot_bcs.py --stage all --n_shots 0 1 5 --counts 8 16 --n_batches 25 --seed 42 2>&1 | tee logs/fewshot_bcs_mitigation.log"
